title: Binance Wallet: Optimize Returns with the Revamped Yield+!
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet  is excited to introduce our latest revamp of  Yield+ .  Yield+ is an on-chain yield strategy product that  optimizes user returns  by providing structured steps for navigating multiple liquid staking and restaking protocols. With Yield+, users can explore 1 to 2 high-yield strategies for the most popular assets, and earn multiple layers of rewards — such as APR and points — on their initial stake.  New Features: APR Surge:  Benefit from regular Boosted APR rewards in the form of campaigns. Seamless User Experience:  Experience a guided staking journey through a series of DeFi protocols with simplified gas-saving contract interaction.  Integrated Experience:  Users can stake directly from the Binance Wallet interface without having to interact with individual dApps.  Currently, Yield+ features curated on-chain strategies for BTC, USDT, USDC, BNB, and SOL, including: BTCB - Solv DeFi Vault  USDT/USDC - PTSUSDe  BNB - Lista BNSOL - Solayer SOL - sSOL WBTC - PTEBTC         To celebrate the revamp of Yield+, we’re introducing three exclusive campaigns from Solv, Ethena, and Solayer for users to share a total rewards pool of  $650,000 worth of project tokens. Promotion Period: 2024-12-19 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2025-01-08 23:59:59 (UTC) 22% APR Boost on BTCB Staking with Solv Share $150,000 in Rewards with Ethena Pendle Strategy Stake SOL to Earn 4x Solayer Bonus More projects and campaigns will be announced during the  Binance Wallet Airdrop Carnival . Stay tuned! How to Stake on Yield+: Update your Binance App to version 2.93.0 or higher. Log into your Binance Wallet on the Binance App. Go to  [Earn] - [ Yield+ ]. Choose your preferred strategy and tap  [Stake]  to get started. Explore Yield+ Today!
